programmes.d: Scout Kit Carson competes with a trapper for the hand of a Native woman.
As a nun aids a wounded robber, she learns he is a friend of the notorious Billy the Kid.
Sadie Orchard, the West's first female freight-line driver, races to deliver a shipment to save her hauling contract.
A tomboy changes her ways when she meets the handsome constable of a mining town.
An incident in the life of Jack London is recreated in this drama about the San Francisco waterfront.
An inexperienced young man hears about a planned ambush on the sheriff and vows to help.
Two prospectors pull a hoax on a banker who wants their mine.
Count Peter intends to wed a don's daughter, but a misunderstanding lands him in hot water.
A desert dwelling couple struggle with life in Death Valley.
Life on the prairie is anything but easy for a newly married Swedish immigrant.
Two Americans on their way to Santa Fe are captured by Mexican troops and held prisoner.
Newlyweds strike it rich with the discovery of borax.
Two members of a wagon train try to reach help before their group dies of starvation.
Jesse Martin stirs up a town: he claims there's a payload of gold lying right beneath Main Street.
Prospectors venture into Death Valley to find a legendary lost mine.
The story of how the Winchester repeating rifle helped to bring law and order to a new Idaho town.
The members of a wagon train rebel against their scout when they lose their way in the Sierra Nevada Mountains.
Two ladies move to Colorado to prove their land claim, but the local land manager intends to own it himself.
James Reavis, who claims to be the baron of Arizona, takes steps to gain possession of his alleged property.
A trapper's temper puts him on the road to trouble.
A dance hall singer asks Lucas to care for her daughter in an effort to hide the baby from her self-righteous, bigoted father.
Lucas becomes involved in a battle between an aspiring writer and a cocky, bragging trail boss.
Mark runs away from home after his father questions his story about overhearing a plot to rob the bank.
A famous buffalo hunter tries to goad Lucas into a shooting match. When Lucas refuses, he becomes the new target.
When a stranger arrives to marry the town spinster, two brothers who want her land try to discourage him with threats and a beating.
Mark finds himself in grave danger when two unscrupulous detectives searching for a man's long-lost son claim that it's Mark.
Lucas is drawn to a young widow passing through town on her way to claim an inheritance but others who covet it are trying to kill her.
After a young stablehand kills a notorious gunslinger, he is baffled by the hostility of the townspeople about giving him the reward.
When a horse dealer transporting a prize stallion stops in North Fork, two saddle tramps try to use trickery to obtain it.
An elderly couple moves to North Fork under an assumed name to hide the fact that they are the parents of a vicious killer. The plan backfires when the son shows up at their home.
After foiling a girl's attempt to rob the general store, Lucas finds that she and her brother are plotting the murder of their abusive stepfather.
A old female peddler is injured when her team of horses bolts. While she recuperates under Lofty's care, Annie writes to her estranged son in Texas, asking him to visit his parent.
A young man is mistaken for a notorious outlaw and has a hard time convincing Diablo's townspeople that he didn't commit a stagecoach robbery.
Annie and Lofty try to close the local gambling hall. It's owner, the son of a legendary lawman, is convinced that making money is more important than being respected.
Jim Bowie intervenes when the French elements attempt to identify John James Audubon as their missing Dauphin — but he prefers American citizenship. Audubon was world-famous as a painter of birds.
Jim Bowie accepts an appointment as a deputy to protect a prisoner from mob violence, who, being son of a French society at odds with Americans, is falsely accused of a crime committed by his father.
Jim Bowie smashes a fur monopoly and makes open bidding available for Louisiana trappers.
A colorful old Louisiana custom almost makes Bowie an involuntary bridegroom when he is mistake for Rafe Bradford, who tried to escape the Broomstick Wedding.
Cisco and Pancho rescue a kilt-clad Scotsman from bandits. Later, he brags to his nephew that he once rode with the Cisco Kid.
A young man is run out of town when he sticks up for an opera singer. Cisco and Pancho step in when outlaws are after the singer's jewels.
Pancho takes his boots to a shoemaker to be stretched and overhears the cobbler plotting illegal activity with a man who steals the boots.
The young Queen-to-be of France hides out in North Fork with her sick brother.
A notorious killer is being held in the North Fork jail. When word gets around that Gordo's gang is on its way to free him, the whole town becomes frightened.
Josh is hired by a woman to sober up Harry a drunk who is also Josh's friend.
Josh and the beautiful female prisoner he is transporting to trial are on a three-day trip while her partner is still on the loose in the area.
